answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind each autonomous agent to a sequentially accrued stake, so an adversary cannot mirror an identity without replaying the full delay function; information-theoretic unforgeability then follows because the transcript space any clone could wander is bounded by entropy loss across epochs. VRF leader sortition anchors finality to stake, and Byzantine quorum intersection on a reputation reef renders equivocation infeasible and spoofing computationally void.
